newsitem.title: GREECE: BEFORE THE BELL: ATHENS MEDICAL-FALIRO STARTS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL: ATHENS MEDICAL-FALIRO STARTS TRADE.

text.p: Bourse newcomer Athens Medical Clinic-Paleo Faliro will make its trade debut on the bourse's small-cap parallel market on Monday, the Athens stock exchange said in a statement.
The Athens Medical Clinic - Paleo Faliro is a subsidiary of main market listing, Athens Medical Centre .
Its recent IPO offerred 317,000 new registered ordinary shares at 1,900 drachmas each, raising 602 million drachmas.
IPO proceeds will finance the purchase of new high-tech medical equipment, construction of new facilities and participation in the Inter-Balkan Medical Centre in Thessaloniki.
The IPO issue was oversubscribed 57 times.

Bank of Piraeus was the lead underwriter and issue advisor joined by co-underwriters Alpha Credit Bank , Agricultural Bank, N.D. Devletoglou Securities, Sarros Brokerage and Sigma Securities. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
